package main import ( "context" "github.com/vuka-lang/ui/v2" ) // Board keeps the hooks of earlier releases: its Mount and Changed found by // their names, and a loader its constructor declares. type Board struct { ui.Live Q string rows []string } func NewBoard() *Board { b := &Board{} b.Loads("rows", (*Board).loadRows) return b } func (b *Board) Mount(ctx context.Context) error { return nil } func (b *Board) Changed(ctx context.Context) error { return nil } func (b *Board) loadRows(ctx context.Context) error { return nil }
